evidence.claim: An analyst requested review of transaction 3660263 on card C01727-K2 due to several cards showing losses with no shared device.

Card C01727-K2 has 5 prior confirmed fraud cases (CC-4908, CC-1975, CC-1833, CC-1501, CC-0723) for patterns such as 'card_not_present_new_device' and 'account_takeover', with the most recent one on 2016-10-16.

A Round-2 detector identified a coordinated recipient-email mule ring across 17 cards, including C01727-K2, paying R_emaildomain='sc.rr.com' with no shared device. Card C01727-K2 has 3 online ProductCD='C' payments (3660261, 3660262, 3660263) totaling $967.68 to 'sc.rr.com'.

The recipient email domain 'sc.rr.com', used by transaction 3660263, is shared with 16 other cards, including C03060-K1 and C11743-K2, which are associated with confirmed fraud cases CC-3907 and CC-5117 respectively.
The transaction amount of $295.92 for transaction 3660263 is within the card's historical range (prior median $107.86, prior maximum $1,419.28 over 121 transactions).
The billing region 231.0 for online transaction 3660263 is the card's modal region, with 119 prior purchases over 90 days.
The purchaser email domain 'gmail.com' for transaction 3660263 has been used 58 times previously on card C01727-K2.
Transaction 3660263 has no identity record, indicating an unknown device rather than a new device.

case.summary: Verdict: Fraud (p=0.92). An L1 block of card C01727-K2 and an L2 SAR filing are recommended, awaiting approval.

sar.narrative: An undocumented coordinated fraud pattern has been identified under internal case ID AC-HHF-006. The primary subjects are customer C01727 and their Visa debit card C01727-K2, along with 16 other connected cards. On 2017-01-17 at 15:29, transaction 3660261 for $305.41 was processed online from region 231.0 using product code C. This was followed by transaction 3660262 for $366.35 online from region 231.0 on 2017-01-18 at 19:40 using product code C, and then transaction 3660263 for $295.92 online from region 231.0 on 2017-01-28 at 07:59 using product code C. This activity forms part of a coordinated recipient-email mule ring across 17 cards, all paying the rare recipient email domain 'sc.rr.com' with no shared device, linking C01727-K2 to cards C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, C02167-K2, C03060-K1, C04146-K1, C04668-K1, C05610-K1, C06115-K1, C06639-K1, C08384-K1, C10350-K1, C11617-K1, C11743-K2, and C11940-K1. This online activity, while within the card's baseline maximum amount of $1,419.28 and in its modal region of 231.0, is suspicious due to the coordinated pattern of shared recipient email across multiple cards, which is inconsistent with ordinary cardholder behavior. A prior suspicious activity report was filed on this card under closed case CC-1975, CC-1833, CC-1501. No prior reports were filed related to connected cards or device profiles. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. A case has been created, monitoring of connected cards has been initiated, and an escalation to an analyst has been done. A block of card C01727-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this suspicious activity report is recommended, awaiting fraud-manager approval, for a total suspicious amount of $967.68.
